measurement_note: Size is L, the total message-character count. Each tier has n = L/4 distinct lexicographically increasing senders, each with the one-word message word, so all totals tie and every map entry must be considered. One aggregation and maximum pass takes O(L) time. Correctly locating every occurrence by rescanning the sender list separately for each distinct sender completes all tiers and fails through O(n^2) scaling.
